# Circle Course Downloader

Circle Course Downloader is an open-source Python command-line tool for saving videos from Circle courses locally for offline viewing.

Canonical site: https://paladini.github.io/circle-courses-downloader/
GitHub repository: https://github.com/paladini/circle-courses-downloader
PyPI package: https://pypi.org/project/circle-course-downloader/

## What it does

- Opens a dedicated Chromium browser for Circle sign-in.
- Discovers course lessons from a Circle course page.
- Detects video streams on lesson pages.
- Downloads videos locally using yt-dlp.
- Writes JSON and CSV manifests with lesson metadata.

## Installation

```bash
python -m pip install circle-course-downloader
python -m playwright install chromium
```

## Usage

```bash
circle-course-downloader download "https://your-community.com/c/course"
```
